answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-bonded registration: each agent locks tokens plus a small proof-of-work puzzle before joining, so creating N fake identities costs N times the bond and compute. A zephyr of new sign-ups can't cheaply flood the meadow of honest traders, and the haven of verified peers stays sybil-free because slashed bonds punish duplicates.
